cvars.name: D3D12.PSO.DiskCache
cvars.description: PSO disk cache. Saves compiled Pipeline State Objects to disk. Reduces shader stutter on subsequent sessions.
cvars.notes: Dune ships with this at 0 (per game log). Enabling can reduce hitching but stays disabled by default.

cvars.name: r.D3D12.PSO.DiskCache
cvars.description: UE5 r.* mirror of D3D12.PSO.DiskCache. Both must be set together.
cvars.notes: Dune ships with this at 0 (per game log).

cvars.name: D3D12.PSO.DriverOptimizedDiskCache
cvars.description: Driver-optimized PSO cache. Allows the GPU driver to further optimize and persist PSOs on top of the standard disk cache.
cvars.notes: Dune ships with this at 0 (per game log).

cvars.name: r.D3D12.PSO.DriverOptimizedDiskCache
cvars.description: UE5 r.* mirror. Both must be set.
cvars.notes: Dune ships with this at 0 (per game log).

cvars.name: D3D12.PSOPrecache.KeepLowLevel
cvars.description: Retain low-level PSO data during precaching. Prevents pipeline object recreation and reduces hitching.

cvars.name: r.D3D12.PSOPrecache.KeepLowLevel
cvars.description: UE5 r.* mirror of above.

cvars.name: r.PSOPrecache.GlobalComputeShaders
cvars.description: Precache global compute shaders at startup. Eliminates runtime stutter when compute shaders are first needed.

cvars.name: r.PSOPrecaching
cvars.description: Master enable for UE5 PSO precaching. Must be on for the precache system to function.

cvars.name: r.D3D.ForceDXC
cvars.description: Force DirectX Shader Compiler (DXC) over legacy FXC. Enables Shader Model 6.x features and better GPU bytecode for DX12.
cvars.notes: Some users report shader compile hitches on certain AMD driver versions when forcing DXC. Test before keeping.

cvars.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.StartupMode
cvars.range: 0 = off  1 = load only  2 = fast compile  3 = full background compile
cvars.description: Startup PSO precompilation aggressiveness. Mode 3 = full background compile — longer load screen, smoother gameplay.

cvars.name: D3D12.AFRUseFramePacing
cvars.description: Frame pacing for Alternate Frame Rendering. Only meaningful on multi-GPU AFR setups.

cvars.name: r.PSOPrecache.Resources
cvars.description: Include resource binding layouts in the PSO precache. Fewer runtime cache misses.

cvars.name: r.IO.UseDirectStorage
cvars.description: Enable DirectStorage. GPU decompresses assets directly from NVMe, bypassing CPU. Faster streaming on compatible hardware + Windows 10/11.

cvars.name: r.Shaders.Optimize
cvars.description: Optimize compiled shaders for GPU performance at the cost of longer compile times.

cvars.name: r.Shaders.ForceDXC
cvars.description: Force DXC for all SystemSettings shaders. Enables SM6 features (wave intrinsics, etc.) across all shader types.
cvars.notes: Same caveat as r.D3D.ForceDXC — can cause hitches on some AMD setups.

cvars.name: r.Shaders.RemoveDeadCode
cvars.description: Strip unused code paths from compiled shaders. Smaller, faster shaders with less register pressure.

cvars.name: r.Shaders.RemoveUnusedInterpolators
cvars.description: Remove vertex-to-pixel interpolators that are never read. Minor perf gain, cleaner shader assembly.

cvars.name: r.AllowMultiThreadedShaderCreation
cvars.description: Create RHI shaders on multiple threads. Reduces hitches when new materials are encountered at runtime.

cvars.name: r.CompileShadersForDevelopment
cvars.description: 0 disables development-only shader permutations. Shipping setting — removes debug paths and reduces compile count.

cvars.name: r.ForceAllCoresForShaderCompiling
cvars.description: Use all CPU cores for background shader compilation. Cuts compile time significantly; may cause system slowness during compile bursts.

cvars.name: r.ThreadedShaderCompilation
cvars.description: Compile shaders on worker threads. Avoids game-thread hitches when new shader permutations stream in.

cvars.name: r.ShaderDrawDebug
cvars.description: Disable shader debug overlay drawing. Developer-only — disabling removes its overhead.

cvars.name: r.ShaderLibrary.PrintExtendedStats
cvars.description: Suppress verbose shader library statistics logging.

cvars.name: r.DynamicGlobalIlluminationMethod
cvars.description: Select global illumination method. 1 = Lumen — indirect lighting, color bleeding, emissive bounce light.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing
cvars.description: Enable hardware ray tracing for Lumen. Uses DXR for scene representation. Requires RTX or RDNA3 GPU. Higher quality than software Lumen at higher GPU cost.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive. If Dune wasn't cooked with HWRT shaders, enabling this will crash at launch with 'Missing global shader'. Test carefully and remove the entry if launch fails.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.Allow
cvars.description: Allow Lumen to compute diffuse indirect lighting. Core GI feature — ambient and bounce light.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.SSAO
cvars.description: Apply screen-space AO on top of Lumen diffuse indirect. Adds contact shadow detail.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing.FarFieldBias
cvars.description: Distance bias for HWRT far-field hits. Prevents self-intersection on large open terrain.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing.HitLighting.ReflectionCaptures
cvars.description: Use reflection captures at HWRT hit points. Better reflection quality without full denoising cost.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing.Inline
cvars.description: Inline ray tracing mode. More efficient HWRT dispatch on Ampere/RDNA3+ GPUs.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive. Requires HWRT shaders to be cooked into the game; remove the entry if launch crashes.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing.LightingMode
cvars.range: 0 = surface cache  1 = hit lighting (no shadow)  2 = hit lighting  3 = full hit lighting
cvars.description: HWRT Lumen lighting quality. 3 = computes full lighting at every ray hit. Highest quality, most expensive.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.Radiosity.HardwareRayTracing
cvars.description: Use HWRT for Lumen radiosity (surface-to-surface light propagation). More accurate multi-bounce indirect light.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive. Requires HWRT shaders to be cooked into the game; remove the entry if launch crashes with 'Missing global shader'.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.Allow
cvars.description: Enable Lumen reflections on reflective surfaces.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.HardwareRayTracing.Retrace.HitLighting
cvars.description: Retrace reflection rays with full hit lighting. Surfaces reflect actual computed lighting rather than cached probes.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive. Requires HWRT shaders to be cooked into the game; remove the entry if launch crashes with 'Missing global shader'.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.ScreenSpaceReconstruction
cvars.description: Reconstruct reflection data from screen space where HWRT rays miss geometry.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.ScreenTraces
cvars.description: Trace reflection rays in screen space before falling back to HWRT. Cheaper for nearby geometry.

cvars.name: r.lumen.Reflections.Temporal
cvars.description: Temporal accumulation for Lumen reflections. Smooths reflections over frames, reducing noise.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather
cvars.description: Enable Lumen screen probe gather. Core UE5 indirect lighting technique — places probes across the screen to gather GI.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DownsampleFactor
cvars.range: 4 – 32 (powers of 2; lower = more probes = higher quality + cost)
cvars.description: Screen probe grid spacing in pixels. 4–8 = high quality, 16 = default balance, 32 = performance.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.FullResolutionJitterWidth
cvars.description: Jitter amount for probe placement. Reduces grid-pattern banding in indirect lighting.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.IrradianceFormat
cvars.description: Spherical harmonic order for irradiance storage. Note: reverts to SH3 when ShortRangeAO integration is enabled.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.MaterialAO
cvars.description: Compute material-sourced AO inside Lumen probes. Fine contact detail from material properties.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal
cvars.description: Use Hierarchical Z-Buffer traversal for screen-space probe traces. More accurate than brute-force screen tracing.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO
cvars.description: Short-range AO pass in screen probe gather. Adds localized contact shadow detail that global probes miss.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TemporalFilterProbes
cvars.description: Temporally accumulate probe data. Smoother indirect lighting — trades responsiveness for stability.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TracingOctahedronResolution
cvars.description: Angular resolution of each probe's ray hemisphere. 8 = performance, 16 = default, 32 = high quality.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TwoSidedFoliageBackfaceDiffuse
cvars.description: Add back-face diffuse for two-sided foliage materials. Improves light bleed-through on leaves and desert vegetation.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.FrontLayer.Allow
cvars.description: Allow Lumen reflections on translucent surfaces. Needed for water, glass, and other transparent reflectors.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.Enable
cvars.description: Lumen lighting inside volumetric translucency (fog, smoke, dust). Important for sandstorm atmosphere.

cvars.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.FarField
cvars.description: Extend translucency radiance cache to far-field distances. Atmospheric glow at long range.

cvars.name: r.LumenScene.FarField
cvars.description: Enable far-field Lumen scene. Captures geometry beyond normal Lumen range for accurate distant indirect lighting.

cvars.name: r.LumenScene.FarField.FarFieldDitherScale
cvars.description: Dither scale for the near-to-far Lumen scene transition.

cvars.name: r.LumenScene.Heightfield.MaxTracingSteps
cvars.range: 8 – 128 (higher = more accurate terrain ray marching, more cost)
cvars.description: Max ray steps for heightfield tracing. Higher values prevent rays cutting out over complex terrain.

cvars.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity
cvars.description: Enable Lumen radiosity. Propagates light between scene cards — true multi-bounce indirect lighting.

cvars.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.HardwareRayTracing.Indirect
cvars.description: Use HWRT for indirect radiosity rays. More accurate light propagation between surfaces.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive. Requires HWRT shaders to be cooked into the game; remove the entry if launch crashes.

cvars.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.ProbeOcclusion
cvars.description: Occlude radiosity probes using scene geometry. Prevents light leaking through walls.

cvars.name: r.LumenScene.Radiosity.Temporal
cvars.description: Temporal accumulation for radiosity. Smoother, more stable indirect lighting over time.

cvars.name: r.GlobalIllumination.Denoiser.TemporalAccumulation
cvars.description: Temporal denoiser for GI samples. Accumulates rays over multiple frames for cleaner indirect lighting.

cvars.name: r.GenerateMeshDistanceFields
cvars.description: Generate signed distance fields for all meshes. Required for software Lumen tracing, DFAO, and raycast operations.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive — driven by project settings, not safely overridable at runtime. Most UE5 Lumen projects enable this via project setting; in-game default may already be 1 in Dune. Disabling breaks Lumen software path; forcing on may crash if distance-field shaders weren't cooked.

cvars.name: r.AOObjectDistanceField
cvars.description: Enable object distance field AO alongside Lumen. Adds AO detail from distance field volumes.

cvars.name: r.AOSpecularOcclusionMode
cvars.range: 0 = off  1 = on (more accurate DFAO for specular)
cvars.description: More accurate DFAO applied to specular occlusion. Reduces incorrect bright reflections in shadowed areas.

cvars.name: r.AOUseJitter
cvars.description: Disable jitter for DFAO sampling. Reduces noise at cost of subtle aliasing. Generally preferred when temporal AA is active.

cvars.name: r.AmbientOcclusion.Method
cvars.description: Select AO method. DFAO works with Lumen's pipeline and is higher quality than screen-space AO.

cvars.name: r.HeterogeneousVolumes.HardwareRayTracing
cvars.description: HWRT for heterogeneous volumes (sandstorms, smoke, fire). More accurate volumetric lighting.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive. Requires HWRT shaders to be cooked into the game; remove the entry if launch crashes.

cvars.name: landscape.RenderNanite
cvars.description: Render terrain with Nanite. Arrakis landscape uses virtualized geometry — large draw distances, no LOD pop-in.

cvars.name: r.Nanite.AutoShaderCulling
cvars.description: Auto-cull Nanite geometry by shader complexity. Skips expensive material evaluation for occluded or sub-pixel clusters.

cvars.name: r.Nanite.MaterialVisibility
cvars.description: Visibility-test Nanite clusters before shading. Only shades visible clusters — reduces overdraw.

cvars.name: r.GeometryCollection.Nanite
cvars.description: Render destructible geometry collections with Nanite. Destruction debris uses virtualized geometry.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.DistanceField
cvars.description: Enable distance field shadows. Soft, long-range shadow casting from distance field volumes.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.RadiusThreshold
cvars.description: Minimum projected radius for a shadow caster. Lower values force more small objects to cast shadows. Raise to reclaim performance.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.DistantLightMode
cvars.description: Virtual Shadow Map mode for distant directional lights. Efficient shadow page allocation for far sun shadows.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.NonNanite.UseHZB
cvars.description: HZB culling for non-Nanite VSM objects. Reduces shadow rendering cost for regular meshes.

cvars.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.OnePassProjection.MaxLightsPerPixel
cvars.description: Max shadow-casting lights per pixel via VSM. Raising to 32 helps in scenes with many lights but increases cost.

cvars.name: r.NGX.DLSS.AutoExposure
cvars.description: DLSS-managed auto-exposure. Uses DLSS's own exposure estimate rather than the engine's. Notable quality change — worth toggling to compare.

cvars.name: r.NGX.DLSS.Reflections.TemporalAA
cvars.description: DLSS TAA applied to the reflection buffer before upscaling. Reduces shimmer in Lumen reflections.

cvars.name: r.NGX.DLSS.WaterReflections.TemporalAA
cvars.description: DLSS TAA on the water reflection buffer. Smoother still-water reflections.

cvars.name: r.NGX.LogLevel
cvars.description: DLSS/NGX SDK log verbosity.

cvars.name: r.NIS.HalfPrecision
cvars.range: 0 = off  1 = half precision  2 = FXC half  3 = Float16 DXC (UE5 DX12 SM6)
cvars.description: NIS precision mode. 3 = Float16 via DXC, the mode intended for UE5 DX12 SM6 — fastest with minimal quality loss.

cvars.name: r.ParallelRendering
cvars.description: Master switch for multithreaded rendering. Distributes rendering work across CPU threads.

cvars.name: r.ParallelBasePass
cvars.description: Parallel opaque/masked base pass. Distributes mesh draw command recording across threads.

cvars.name: r.ParallelShadows
cvars.description: Master switch for parallel shadow rendering.

cvars.name: r.ParallelShadowDepth
cvars.description: Build shadow depth maps in parallel. Significant gain when multiple shadow-casting lights are active.

cvars.name: r.ParallelCulling
cvars.description: Cull non-visible objects on multiple threads. Reduces CPU time spent on visibility determination.

cvars.name: r.ParallelTranslucency
cvars.description: Render translucent objects in parallel.

cvars.name: r.ParallelPostProcessing
cvars.description: Post-process effects processed in parallel.

cvars.name: r.ParallelAnimationEvaluation
cvars.description: Evaluate skeletal animations on multiple threads. Major win in populated areas — all NPC and player animations run concurrently.

cvars.name: r.ParallelAnimationUpdate
cvars.description: Parallel animation update phase. Works with ParallelAnimationEvaluation for a fully threaded animation pipeline.

cvars.name: r.ParallelMeshDrawCommands
cvars.description: Generate mesh draw commands in parallel. Reduces CPU bottleneck when many objects need rendering.

cvars.name: r.ParallelInitViews
cvars.description: Initialize render view data in parallel. Speeds up per-frame view frustum setup.

cvars.name: r.ParallelPrePass
cvars.description: Parallel early depth pre-pass. Primes the depth buffer so later passes skip occluded pixels.

cvars.name: r.ParallelZPrepass
cvars.description: Additional Z-prepass parallelization. Complements ParallelPrePass.

cvars.name: r.ParallelPhysicsScene
cvars.description: Chaos physics simulation on multiple threads.

cvars.name: r.ParallelDistanceField
cvars.description: Distance field updates processed on multiple threads.

cvars.name: r.ParallelSceneCapture
cvars.description: Scene captures (reflections, cameras, etc.) rendered in parallel.

cvars.name: r.ParallelMeshProcessing
cvars.description: Mesh LOD and streaming data processed in parallel.

cvars.name: r.RHICmdUseParallelAlgorithms
cvars.description: Parallel algorithms in the RHI command list. Parallelizes GPU command recording.

cvars.name: r.RHICmdBuffer.EnableThreadedCompletion
cvars.description: Complete RHI command buffers on worker threads. Frees the render thread earlier each frame.

cvars.name: r.GraphicsThread.EnableBackgroundThreads
cvars.description: Graphics thread offloads heavy tasks to background workers.

cvars.name: r.GraphicsThread.UseThreadedDestruction
cvars.description: Destroy GPU resources on background threads. Prevents resource deletion stalling the render thread.

cvars.name: bAllowMultiThreadedAnimationUpdate
cvars.description: Global engine enable for multithreaded animation updates.

cvars.name: bOptimizeAnimBlueprintMemberVariableAccess
cvars.description: Optimize animation blueprint variable reads for multithreaded access.

cvars.name: TaskGraph.Enable
cvars.description: Enable the UE5 task graph system. Underpins all threaded work in the engine.

cvars.name: gc.MultithreadedDestructionEnabled
cvars.description: Garbage-collect and destroy UObjects on multiple threads. Prevents GC spikes on the game thread.

cvars.name: r.AllowStaticLighting
cvars.description: Cook-time setting controlling which static-lighting shader permutations are available. Dune ships cooked with this at 0 (Lumen-only).
cvars.notes: READ-ONLY cook-time cvar — do not override. Anything other than 0 has been observed to crash or destabilize Dune (most commonly 'Missing global shader FMoveWholeIndirectionTextureCS' at launch) because the corresponding static-lighting shaders aren't cooked into the .pak files. Strongly recommend leaving at 0 or removing this entry from your Engine.ini entirely.

cvars.name: r.Streaming.LimitPoolSizeToVRAM
cvars.description: Cap texture pool to available VRAM. Prevents over-allocation that causes stutter or OOM crashes on lower-VRAM GPUs.

cvars.name: r.Streaming.MaxMipLevelReduction
cvars.range: 0 – 8 (0 = no reduction; higher = streaming may drop mip levels under VRAM pressure)
cvars.description: Max mip levels streaming can drop under memory pressure. 0 = always full resolution.
cvars.notes: Setting to 0 is fine on 8GB+ VRAM. On smaller GPUs it can cause severe texture pop-in or OOM crashes when streaming gets pressured.

cvars.name: r.Streaming.UseBackgroundThreadPool
cvars.description: Texture streaming I/O on background thread pool. Keeps the game thread responsive while assets load.

cvars.name: r.Streaming.UseNewMetrics
cvars.description: Improved streaming heuristics for mip level selection. Better texture resolution decisions at distance.

cvars.name: r.IO.VirtualTextures
cvars.description: Enable virtual texturing. Streams texture pages on demand — supports texture sets larger than VRAM.
cvars.notes: Cook-time sensitive. If Dune wasn't cooked with virtual texturing enabled, forcing this on can crash at launch with 'Missing global shader' (typically a virtual texture indirection compute shader). Remove the entry if launch fails.

cvars.name: s.ProcessPrestreamingRequests
cvars.description: Process prestreaming hints. Engine pre-fetches assets before you arrive at a location.

cvars.name: r.RenderTargetPoolMin
cvars.description: Preallocated render target pool in MB. Larger values avoid runtime RT allocation hitches for complex scenes.

cvars.name: p.Chaos.PerParticleCollision.ISPC
cvars.description: ISPC-vectorized per-particle Chaos collision. Accelerates cloth and soft body collision detection on CPU.

cvars.name: p.Chaos.Spherical.ISPC
cvars.description: ISPC vectorization for spherical Chaos constraints. Faster cloth springiness and tension calculations.

cvars.name: p.Chaos.TriangleMesh.ISPC
cvars.description: ISPC vectorization for Chaos triangle mesh collision. Faster detection for complex shapes.

cvars.name: p.Chaos.VelocityField.ISPC
cvars.description: ISPC vectorization for Chaos velocity fields (wind, drag). Relevant for cloaks and fabric in sandstorms.

cvars.name: r.VSync
cvars.description: VSync. Synchronizes GPU output to monitor refresh. Disabling eliminates VSync input lag but may cause screen tearing — best paired with G-Sync or FreeSync.

cvars.name: r.Fog
cvars.description: Atmospheric fog. Distance haze and atmospheric scattering.
cvars.notes: Setting to 0 is a common 'performance' tweak but dramatically alters Dune's atmosphere — sandstorms, distant haze, sunset look all flatten significantly. Caves may also appear differently lit.

cvars.name: r.DontLimitOnBattery
cvars.description: Disable battery-saver framerate cap. Only relevant on laptops.

cvars.name: r.EarlyZPass
cvars.range: 0 = off  1 = opaque + masked  2 = force all  3 = auto
cvars.description: Early depth prepass mode. Auto (3) is the default. Later passes skip shading of occluded pixels.

cvars.name: r.EarlyZPassMovable
cvars.description: Include movable/dynamic objects in the Z-prepass. Characters and moving objects benefit from early depth culling.

cvars.name: r.GTSyncType
cvars.description: Game thread sync method. 2 = sync to GPU completion fence, reducing input latency.

cvars.name: r.FinishCurrentFrame
cvars.description: Force-finish current frame early. Default 0 allows frame pipelining for better throughput at cost of ~1 frame of latency.

cvars.name: r.OneFrameThreadLag
cvars.description: 1-frame lag between game and render threads.
cvars.notes: Setting to 0 reduces input latency but can drop framerate noticeably on CPU-bound systems. Trade-off worth testing per-machine.

cvars.name: r.DynamicRes.OperationMode
cvars.description: Dynamic resolution scaling mode. 0 = always render at fixed resolution.

cvars.name: r.DefaultFeature.LightUnits
cvars.description: Light intensity unit system. 1 = candelas (UE5 default), 2 = Lux for physically-based calibration.

cvars.name: r.DumpGPU
cvars.description: GPU frame dump captures. Developer diagnostic — off for normal play.

cvars.name: r.tonemapper.sharpen
cvars.description: Tonemapper sharpening filter. Runs in the final tonemapper pass. Useful post-DLSS to restore detail. High values can produce edge haloing.

cvars.name: r.SSR.ExperimentalDenoiser
cvars.description: Experimental denoiser for screen-space reflections. Cleaner SSR where Lumen doesn't fully cover.

cvars.name: r.SSR.HalfResSceneColor
cvars.description: Compute SSR at half resolution. Performance trade-off — slightly softer reflections, noticeably faster.

cvars.name: r.SSS.Burley.BilateralFilterKernelFunctionType
cvars.description: Subsurface scattering filter kernel variant. 0 vs 1 trades quality for performance. Specific behavior differences not publicly detailed.

cvars.name: FX.AllowCulling
cvars.description: Cull off-screen particle systems. Prevents non-visible particles consuming GPU time.

cvars.name: FX.AllowGPUSorting
cvars.description: Sort GPU particles for correct transparency ordering. Needed for proper smoke and dust blending.

cvars.name: fx.Niagara.DebugDraw.Enabled
cvars.description: Niagara particle debug draw. Developer diagnostic.

cvars.name: fx.ParticlePerfStats.Enabled
cvars.description: Particle performance statistics collection.

cvars.name: RawMouseInputEnabled
cvars.description: Raw mouse input. Bypasses Windows acceleration for consistent 1:1 movement.

cvars.name: AudioThread.EnableBatchProcessing
cvars.description: Batch audio processing on the audio thread. More efficient CPU audio mixing.

cvars.name: r.Renderer.UseGPUInstancing
cvars.description: GPU instancing for repeated meshes. Single draw call renders many identical objects — important for rocks, structures, ground scatter.

cvars.name: OverrideTriggerBenchmark
cvars.description: Skip automatic scalability benchmark on first run. Preserves configured settings instead of overwriting with auto-detected values.

cvars.name: csv.trackWaitsGT
cvars.description: CSV profiling of game-thread waits. Dev profiling — disabling removes overhead.

cvars.name: csv.trackWaitsRT
cvars.description: CSV profiling of render-thread waits.
